# VaultRAG benchmark (generated by `scripts/benchmark.py`)

**Test conditions:** in-memory SQLite; synthetic seed data (9 documents, 6 users); `extractive` offline model (deterministic, non-generative) so results measure the *authorization pipeline*, not LLM answer quality; hashing embeddings; single process on one machine; tiny suite (6 secrets x 5 users, 10 legitimate queries). Latencies are indicative only. Zero observed leaks in this suite is **not** a proof of zero leakage.

| Metric | Conventional RAG | Permission-filtered RAG | VaultRAG (RSEG) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Unauthorized disclosures / probes | 23 / 23 | 0 / 23 | 0 / 23 |
| Leaks after revocation (cached) / probes | 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 | 0 / 2 |
| Leaks when revoked mid-generation / probes | 2 / 2 | 2 / 2 | 0 / 2 |
| Revocation-enforcement latency, first post-revoke query (p50 ms) | 0.04 | 0.05 | 0.32 |
| Legitimate answers correct / total | 10 / 10 | 10 / 10 | 10 / 10 |
| False refusals / legitimate queries | 0 / 10 | 0 / 10 | 0 / 10 |
| Cache correct after document replacement | NO (stale) | NO (stale) | yes |
| Latency, cold pipeline p50 / p95 (ms) | 0.41 / 0.51 | 0.27 / 0.4 | 0.4 / 0.51 |
| Latency, cache-hit p50 / p95 (ms) | 0.03 / 0.03 | 0.03 / 0.03 | 0.11 / 0.15 |
